adoption.next_action: manual adoption review; do not treat as reviewer pass

errors: pack tree digest does not match review report

status_taxonomy.blocked: Required local observation or filesystem operation is unavailable.
status_taxonomy.deferred: Recognized later-stage responsibility; never treated as pass.
status_taxonomy.fail: Input schema or required selected-fill data is invalid.
status_taxonomy.pass: Selected skeleton fill validation passed; adoption remains unreviewed.
status_taxonomy.rejected: A safety boundary, unauthorized authority claim, or extra section fill was detected.
status_taxonomy.stale: Local assurance, selected skeleton, review digest, or candidate target snapshot no longer matches.
status_taxonomy.unreviewed: Artifact adoption state, not an execution status.
